name: Saudi law: the Basic Law of Governance (1992) and the Labour Law (2005), with their amendments
label: Saudi Arabia
acts: النظام الأساسي للحكم (Basic Law of Governance)
record_note: Later versions are replayed from the BOE's amendment notes; no official consolidation exists to check them. Original texts and every amendment note printed by the Bureau of Experts portal (laws.boe.gov.sa, Wayback captures of January 2026), replayed; checked 2026-10-28. Later versions are replays of editorial notes, not official consolidations; 1 note(s) could not be applied exactly and are named in Not-applied trailers. Dates of royal decrees without a stated commencement are the decree day (In-force-basis).

dates.calendar: Gregorian dates converted from the Hijri (Umm al-Qura) dates printed by the source; Hijri kept in *-hijri trailers

scope.when_absent: this corpus records no scope notes (no commit carries Applies:); the absence is not a statement that the change reaches every case

default_reach.rule: no retroactive effect of laws; no crime or penalty without a text, and no punishment for acts before the text
default_reach.meaning: a law applies from its in-force day and does not reach back unless it says so; penal provisions never reach acts done before them
default_reach.authority: Basic Law of Governance, art. 38 ("ولا عقاب إلا على الأعمال اللاحقة للعمل بالنص النظامي") and art. 71 (laws take effect on publication unless another date is set)

replayed: yes: every version after the original text of each law is replayed from the portal's notes
citation_note: Saudi texts cite articles by ordinal words (المادة (السابعة والثلاثين)), so the numeric rule finds few citations
